description: Validator failure → remediator command dispatch (SSOT for /remediate-app)

typecheck.intent_template:
TypeScript type-check failed during remediation campaign {campaign_id} iter {iteration} wave {wave_index} attempt {attempt}. Fix compiler errors without widening types unsafely. Output:
{evidence}

vitest.intent_template:
Unit tests failed during remediation campaign {campaign_id} iter {iteration} wave {wave_index} attempt {attempt}. Fix production code or test expectations as appropriate. Output:
{evidence}

go_test.intent_template:
Go tests failed during remediation campaign {campaign_id} iter {iteration} wave {wave_index} attempt {attempt}. Fix failing packages. Output:
{evidence}

build.intent_template:
Production build failed during remediation campaign {campaign_id} iter {iteration} attempt {attempt}. Fix build errors and broken imports. Output:
{evidence}

playwright.intent_template:
Playwright E2E failed during campaign {campaign_id} iter {iteration} attempt {attempt}. Fix runtime/module/navigation regressions. Output:
{evidence}

playwright_infra.handoff: Start dev server (see project.config.json remediation.verify.dev_server) then re-run remediator-gate
